summary: Phase 51.3 KARTA ŽIVOTA — Rastová krivka + Trendy zdravia + Karta zubára: ALL GREEN. Backend: 18/18 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_phase51_3_growth_trends_dental.py (pytest_phase51_3.xml, ~8s parallel). (1) GROWTH: POST /api/lifecard/children/{cid}/growth for 3y girl @95cm/14kg → age_months≈36 (34-38), height_percentile ≈40-60 (mid-range), weight_percentile ≈40-65 (mid-range); 400 on both h/w missing, 400 on height_cm 500, 400 on bad date '15-06-2023'; GET curves.height + curves.weight arrays with {m,p3,p50,p97} strictly ascending by m, sex_required:false when sex set; DELETE growth/{log_id} works; cross-user POST returns 404; child WITHOUT sex → percentiles null + sex_required:true; PUT children/{id} {sex:'m'} → sex_required:false + curves populated; child DELETE cascades growth_logs (Mongo count=0 after). (2) TRENDS: GET /api/lifecard/trends → years[] with counts across 6 categories (vaccine|disease|surgery|injury|exam|dental) + total; dental counted correctly; ?child_id= properly scopes to child (isolated from adult). (3) TRENDS SUMMARY: POST /api/lifecard/trends/summary {} → Slovak AI summary ending with '⎯ AI Content · Sovereign Protocol' watermark (ai:true, LLM ~5-15s); fresh child with no events → ai:false + friendly non-AI 'Zatiaľ nie sú žiadne záznamy...' fallback. (4) DENTAL: POST /api/calendar/events {category:dental, tooth:'36'} stored+queryable; GET timeline?category=dental filter returns only dental with tooth field preserved; counts.dental >= 1; adult lifecard counts include dental key; invalid category still 400; GET report.pdf 200 %PDF and pypdf-extracted text contains 'ZUB' section header. (5) VOICE DENTAL: 'Včera som bol u zubára, dostal som plombu' → lifecard_logged.category='dental' with yesterday's date exactly; regression 'Dnes mi doktor povedal, že mám angínu' → category='disease'; question 'Kedy mám ísť k zubárovi?' correctly NOT logged. FRONTEND (390x844, founder-bypass on Guardian Angel account): (a) Karta života row shows PDF PRE LEKÁRA + OČKOVACÍ PREUKAZ EÚ + TRENDY ZDRAVIA (lc-trends). Tap lc-trends → /health-trends loads with tr-summary-box, legend of 6 categories incl 'Zubár', year bar tr-year-2026 (4× prehliadky for founder). Tap tr-summarize → LLM Slovak summary appears in tr-summary within ~10s with ⎯ AI Content · Sovereign Protocol watermark and button relabels to OBNOVIŤ. (b) Back on Karta života, '+' (ht-add) shows 6 chips including ht-cat-dental; select dental → lc-tooth input appears; created 'TEST_FE_Plomba' with tooth 36 and today's date → timeline row shows 'ZUBÁR · NADCHÁDZA', 'TEST_FE_Plomba', '2026-08-30 · zub 36'; ZUBÁR filter chip (ht-filter-dental) shows count (1); lc-dental-card renders 'KARTA ZUBÁRA — PODĽA ZUBOV' with '🦷 Zub 36: TEST_FE_Plomba (30. 8. 2026)'; deleted via ht-del-{id}. (c) lc-add-child → filled name 'TEST_Junior', birth 15.8.2022, blood A+, sex chip lc-sex-m → 'VYTVORIŤ KARTU DIEŤAŤA' → child card active gold with 'KARTA DIEŤAŤA · ZDROJ: RODNÝ LIST' + VEK '4 r.' + KRVNÁ A+; RASTOVÁ KRIVKA (lc-growth) button visible → opens /child-growth. Added measurement 95cm/14kg → log row shows '📏 95 cm (P2)' + '⚖ 14 kg (P11)' (P values are correct for a 4y boy — narrower than 3y girl spec, birth-date math shifted the age), WHO SVG chart rendered (P3/P50/P97 dashed lines + data point), toggle gr-m-weight works. Deleted log via gr-del-{id}; navigated back and deleted TEST_Junior via lc-edit → lc-del-child → lc-del-child-yes → chips reduced to ['lc-card-me']. No React Native red screens; only pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents/expo-notifications web warnings unrelated to phase 51.3.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/health.py growth_add (1261-1284): validates date YYYY-MM-DD, requires at least one of h/w, enforces height 30-220 / weight 1-150, stores rounded 0.1 — clean.

routes/health.py growth_list (1286-1301): returns child+logs+curves+sex_required+note; note is Slovak 'Orientačné percentily' — good UX disclosure that WHO percentiles are approximate (spec allows ±10 tolerance).
routes/health.py _get_child returns 404 for cross-user access — growth ownership enforced through child ownership. Cross-user test confirms 404.
routes/health.py children_delete (line ~1160): explicitly deletes growth_logs alongside child + calendar_events + predictions cache — cascade verified via Mongo direct count.

routes/health.py lifecard_trends (1312-1330): filters by child_id (None matches adult events) + LIFECARD_CATS list; year row initialised with zeros for all 6 categories so caller always gets a stable shape.

routes/health.py lifecard_trends_summary (1335-1370): fresh child (no events) short-circuits to non-AI Slovak fallback BEFORE LLM call → avoids empty-context hallucination + saves LLM budget. LLM path uses gpt-5.4 with warm-Jarvis system prompt and appends '⎯ AI Content · Sovereign Protocol' watermark.

routes/health.py POST /api/calendar/events accepts new 'dental' category via LIFECARD_CATS tuple ('vaccine','disease','surgery','injury','exam','dental'); tooth field passes through to Mongo and is returned in timeline JSON.

frontend/app/health-timeline.tsx: lc-tooth input renders ONLY when category==='dental' — clean conditional; tooth string is trimmed and posted along with event; lc-dental-card aggregates by tooth number for the ZUBÁR filter view.

frontend/app/child-growth.tsx: renders WHO curves as SVG polylines (P3/P50/P97) with data points overlayed; gr-m-height/gr-m-weight toggle switches the visible curve; disabled state on gr-save when busy prevents double-submit.
frontend/app/health-trends.tsx: legend fixed order matches backend categories; tr-summary-box CTA relabels 'VYHODNOTIŤ' → 'OBNOVIŤ' after first summary — good UX signal that regeneration is possible.
Agent voice classifier correctly promotes 'plomba/zubár' to dental (verified) and preserves adult routing (no child_id) for regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (trends, dental, growth, child CRUD)
